hoy.titular: Today from 5pm: a new sale of seated tickets for the final
hoy.resumen: The club secured more category 2 seats (Olímpica stand at the Centenario, USD 250) for members who missed out, by points ranking, and there will also be a general sale. The squad travel to Córdoba this afternoon for Thursday's Supercopa, without Tucu Correa or Alexis Castro.
puntos: Seats for members at libertadores.eleventickets.com (choose «Socio Estudiantes»): 5–8pm, 545 to 400 points (outside La Plata 362 to 290); 8–10pm, 399 to 200 (289 to 150); 10pm–midnight, 199 to 0 (149 to 0). Very few available: points do not guarantee a ticket.
Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, in the UNO app): Thursday 12 for members with 400+ points, Friday 13 for the rest, Saturday 14 general sale.
Supercopa tickets: online via Deportick, from ARS 65,000 to ARS 140,000, with ID.

linea.texto: The club announced a new sale of category 2 seats for the final: members by ranking from Window 2, plus the general public, today from 5pm.
The club confirmed Alexis Castro has a grade 2 calf tear: he misses the Supercopa and is a doubt for the final.
With Castro ruled out, Medina tried two options to replace him against Independiente Rivadavia.
The reserves beat San Martín (SJ) 3-0 at City Bell, with another fine afternoon from Franco Domínguez Ávila, and remain in the play-off race.
